en.headline: FEHD issues vermin notice to Langham Place after rat video
en.dek: The department ordered the Mong Kok shopping centre's management to eliminate conditions conducive to rodents by 6 August or face possible prosecution.
body: The Food and Environmental Hygiene Department has issued a Notice of Elimination of Vermin to the management of Langham Place in Mong Kok after a video of a rat running along a handrail inside the shopping centre circulated online.

FEHD staff inspected the common areas and food premises on Thursday and found signs of rodent activity, holes in false ceilings, and a licensed food premises with an improperly covered rubbish bin in its food room. These conditions could allow rodents to enter, find food and shelter, the department said.

Officers provided hygiene advice and noted that the shopping centre had already arranged for a pest control company to carry out thorough cleaning and strengthen anti-rodent measures. A verbal warning was also issued to the person in charge of the food premises.

Under section 47(1) of the Public Health and Municipal Services Ordinance, the notice requires the property management to take necessary steps to remove conditions conducive to rodent infestation by 6 August, failing which prosecution may be instituted. The FEHD said it would continue to monitor the site and take further action if needed.

zh.headline: 食環署向朗豪坊發消除蟲鼠通知 限期8月6日前改善
zh.dek: 旺角朗豪坊有影片顯示老鼠沿扶手奔跑，食環署巡查後發現鼠跡及天花孔洞，向管理方發出法定通知，否則可被檢控。
body: 食物環境衞生署回應網上有影片顯示老鼠在旺角朗豪坊扶手奔跑後，即時派員巡查商場公用地方及食肆，並向管理方發出消除蟲鼠通知。
巡查期間，食環署發現有鼠患跡象、假天花有孔洞，以及一間持牌食肆的食物室垃圾桶蓋未有妥善蓋好，情況不理想，可能方便老鼠進出、覓食及匿藏。
署方已向商場管理層及職員提供防鼠及環境衞生建議，並得悉商場已安排滅蟲公司徹底清潔及加強防鼠措施。有關食肆負責人亦獲發出口頭警告。
根據《公眾衞生及市政條例》第47(1)條，通知要求朗豪坊管理方在8月6日前採取必要措施消除有利鼠患的情況，否則可被檢控。食環署表示會繼續監察，並按實際情況採取適當行動。
